documents.title: TRANSCRIPT OF ANALYST/ INVESTOR EARNINGS CALL HELD ON 02.11.2026
UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Board Meeting Outcome for UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: Nitin Spinners reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue for the third consecutive time in Q2 FY27 at INR 985.2 crores, driven by higher yarn realization, stable demand, and higher sales volume in the fabric business. EBITDA for the quarter reached INR 175.5 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.8%, while PAT stood at INR 88.7 crores. Management stated that partial trials have commenced for expansion projects, with commercial production across all divisions expected by the end of December 2026. Renewable energy projects are progressing on schedule to be operational by December 2026, increasing renewable capacity to about 95 megawatts and meeting 50% to 55% of power needs post expansion. Nitin Spinners reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance, achieving record-high quarterly revenue, exports, and fabric segment revenue alongside improved EBITDA margins.

guidance.claim: The company aspires to reach revenues between INR 4,800 crores to INR 5,000 crores in FY29.
guidance.quote: So we are expecting that by going in FY29, we aspire that we should reach anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by -- with our existing assets and balancing some of them.

guidance.claim: The company targets a revenue CAGR of approximately 15 percent.
Fabric revenue is projected to rise to about 30 percent of total revenue by financial year 2028.
guidance.quote: Fabric rises to ~30% of revenue by FY28

guidance.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 FY27.
guidance.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

guidance.claim: The company guided that its margins should remain in the range of 16% to 20%.
guidance.quote: I guided or have informed that the kind of product mix which our company has, we should be in the range of 16% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: Yarn demand stayed healthy with steady buying from major importing countries and domestic players amid a stable tariff environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Yarn demand stayed healthy with steady buying from major importing countries as well as domestic players, amid stable tariff environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The medium to long-term outlook for the industry remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: But the medium to long-term outlook for the industry remains positive.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports contributed 68 percent to quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports contributed 68% to the quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better.
demand_outlook.quote: We anticipate that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by demand coming from growth across the downstream sector and the consolidation of the spinning industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The recently implemented India-UK FTA is expected to support India's exports.
demand_outlook.quote: The recently implemented India U.K. FTA is also expected to support India's exports by opening up new sourcing and export opportunities for the Indian textile sector.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10% primarily driven by overall lower global production and supply chain challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.

capex_expansion.claim: Partial trials have commenced in all the segments of the expansion projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding capex, we are pleased to inform that partial trials have commenced in all the segments of the expansion projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production in all divisions is expected to commence by the end of December 2026 as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production in all the divisions is expected to commence by the end of December '26 as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Renewable energy project investments are progressing per schedule and are expected to become operational by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: On renewable project investments, are progressing per schedule and expected to get operational by end of December '26.

capex_expansion.claim: Renewable energy capacity will increase from 41 megawatts to about 95 megawatts.
capex_expansion.quote: This will take our renewable energy capacity from 41 megawatt to about 95 megawatt and meeting about 50% to 55% of power needs post expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production of griege woven fabric has commenced as part of the brownfield expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity expansion front, we have commenced trial production of griege woven fabric.

capex_expansion.claim: The projects are in advanced stages of commissioning with partial trial production already commenced, and full commissioning expected by December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced. Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, our -- one of our future growth driver will be our capacity addition, which is going -- progressing as schedule with the expansion of our fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 17.8% compared to 13.1% in Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.8% as against 13.1% in Q2 FY26, that is an expansion of 471 basis points and was sustained at the Q1 FY27 level of 17.78%.

margins_costs.claim: Cost pressures are being observed on input costs including dyes, chemicals, coal, packaging costs, and freights.
margins_costs.quote: We are seeing a lot of the input costs going up, including the dyes, chemicals, coal, packaging costs, the freights are increasing.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8 percent, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization, and ongoing cost saving measures.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization and ongoing cost saving measures.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 17.78%, representing an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for this quarter stood at 17.78% against Q1 FY26 margins of 14.02% is an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis and 261 bps on quarter-on-quarter basis.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR75.3 crores, reflecting an 83.63% growth year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR75.3 crores is a growth of 83.63% on year-on-year basis and 31.2% on quarter-on-quarter basis.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2 FY27, spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q2 FY27, the spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.

orders_capacity.claim: Spinning capacity operated at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In FY27, our spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Total term debt is expected to peak this March at about INR 1,440 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: First of all, the peak debt which we are going to have will be about our total term debt will peak in this March at about INR1,440 crores, I think.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital is at about INR 400 crores and can reach about INR 500 crores plus during that time.
capital_allocation.quote: And working capital, which is at about INR400 crores at this point of time, can reach maybe about INR500 crores plus during that time.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the near term, inflationary conditions across commodities and services and liquidity strain in downstream channels are factors to be closely watched.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the near term, the inflationary conditions across commodities and services and liquidity strain in the downstream channels are factors which are closely to be watched.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production in all divisions is expected to commence by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production in all the divisions is expected to commence by the end of December '26 as planned.

management_commitments.claim: Renewable projects are expected to get operational by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: On renewable project investments, are progressing per schedule and expected to get operational by end of December '26.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend in the range of INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores for modernization and other things in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. In the next year, we are -- since we are planning to modernize and rebalance our capacities, we expect that we'll be spending in the range of about INR80 crores to INR100 crores for our modernization and other things.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of the ongoing expansion projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

management_commitments.claim: Yarn capacities are expected to be ramped up by 31st of March of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we would have ramped up all our capacities by 31st of March of this financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
